id: title:dmarchuk:reload the test panel sample event when trigger filters change

review.posthog_relevance: Adds account filtering and request debouncing to Hogflow sample event queries, potentially improving performance and preventing false error reporting for users configuring workflows.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F2 contains substantive frontend implementation changes: P1.F2.H6 adds account filtering logic, P1.F2.H10 adds request debouncing, and P1.F2.H13 distinguishes breakpoint errors. These are bounded, implementation-visible improvements to Hogflow execution. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only maintenance is demonstrated. Tier 2 is assigned.
review.uncertainty: Chunk P1.F1 lacks supplied hunk IDs, preventing inspection of its contribution; tier assignment relies solely on P1.F2. No backend or shared type definitions are supplied, so it is unverified whether these frontend checks are wired into live workflow or remain isolated. No release notes or adoption metrics are available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend test implementation. No supplied hunk IDs are available, so no observations can be made. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new typed parameter and its implementation to the Hogflow editor's sample-loading and account-filtering logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the workflow trigger is configured to filter out test accounts, and propagates that setting to the sample event query.

observations.behavior: Adds a debounce delay to the sample event loading to avoid collapsing concurrent requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces unnecessary repeated queries while the user is editing filters, potentially improving perceived performance.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to distinguish between a breakpoint error and other errors, and re-throws the breakpoint error.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the workflow execution to distinguish between a cancelled request and a genuine failure, preventing false error reporting.
